Code P0300: Ignition System / Fuel Delivery Misfire

Component Health Rating: High Wear Detected 32% Remaining Integrity
CLINICAL REMEDY STEP:

Oscilloscope test spark coils, inspect spark plugs for electrode erosion, check fuel injector delivery pulses, and verify compression across all cylinders at 1 Workshop Lane.

URGENT ENGINE SAFEGUARD ESTIMATED WORKSHOP TIME: 3.5 HOURS

Code P0011: Timing Belt Alignment & Camshaft Synchronization

Timing Belt Wear Status: Critical Replacement Window 15% Remaining Integrity
CLINICAL REMEDY STEP:

Immediate physical inspection of timing belt structural tension and tooth profile. Replace timing belt kit, tensioner pulleys, and water pump using manufacturer locking tools.

CHASSIS SAFETY SYSTEM ESTIMATED DIAGNOSTIC TIME: 30 MINS

Code C0035: ABS & Wheel Speed Telemetry Interruption

Sensor Signal Quality: Intermittent Contact 48% Signal Fidelity
CLINICAL REMEDY STEP:

Verify harness continuity, clean magnetic reluctor ring, inspect speed sensor probe face for metallic debris, and re-calibrate ABS ECU live stream feedback.

EMISSIONS & EXHAUST ESTIMATED DIAGNOSTIC TIME: 60 MINS

Code P0420: Exhaust Gas Telemetry & Catalyst Performance

O2 Sensor Response Time: Sluggish 55% Catalyst Operational Index
CLINICAL REMEDY STEP:

Perform upstream and downstream Lambda sensor waveform analysis, test for exhaust gas leaks ahead of catalyst, and execute full emissions analyzer check for MOT compliance.
